runtime.officialUi: the @deepseek-ai/dsh Web UI in the shell window, plus the Mega Core client plugin

builtIn.acts: observe -> evaluate -> decision (NO_ACTION / THROTTLE / PAUSE_NEW_WORK / REQUEST_RESTART); it cannot stop, spawn or restart anything
the one application restart executor: budget, cooldown, backoff, crash-loop ladder, safe mode, lifecycle, readiness, and an out-of-process companion

seams.continuity: app/core/task-continuity.cjs, handed to the supervisor at boot
seams.admission: app/core/work-admission.cjs, read by the scheduler before it starts work
seams.actionVocabulary: app/core/contracts/service-actions.cjs, shared by the page, the panel and the bridge
seams.taskTargets: app/reboot/targets.cjs, driven by both restart paths

ui.floatingBall: the official shell.overlay ball by default; the system-wide window (app/extensions/mega/system-orb.cjs) is opt-in and the host stands the in-UI ball down when it is running
ui.officialUiFallback: the settings section draws the service roster, the restart record, the advanced policy and the product actions
